'''Dorele''' is an [[Atha'an Miere]] sailor on the ''[[Wavedancer]]''. 

== Appearance ==
She is slender and has only one ring in each ear.

== Activities ==
She serves tea to [[Elayne Trakand]] and [[Nynaeve al'Meara]] while they are negotiating the "gift of passage" with [[Coine din Jubai Wild Winds]]. She is bare to the waist and is disciplined since they are not a day away from shore.{{ref/book|4|19}}
